content.comment_body: At our site, the wireless signal strength changes often, and it would be helpful to monitor this using the [product_name] basis module. Within the signals menu, I can access '[product_name] communication module / Connection status wireless mobile network.' This status appears as only on/off, and remains 'on' even when signal strength is low and the indicator LED on the module is off. Is there any method to read the actual signal quality or signal strength value and send it to a VM for use by the basis module? For example, signal strength (CSQ / dBm) 6 / -101 dBm.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to monitor detailed cellular signal strength or quality using the [product_name] communication module. However, they find the module only reports a basic on/off connection status, lacking more detailed metrics like signal quality. This limitation restricts effective monitoring and troubleshooting, particularly in locations with varying signal reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to obtain actual signal strength information such as dBm or CSQ from the [product_name] communication module, instead of a basic connection status.
